X5 rule, written 2026-10-31T05:03:56+07:00 before any X5 data exists (replaces a draft of the same day that was never run). Final: do not edit after the run starts. Not from a source. Not reviewed by the user (goal of 2026-10-31, advisor review before launch).
Question (U20): page 01 assumes the NPU time does not depend on the input values or on the weight values ('chưa kiểm'). Is the run time the same for different inputs and for a model with the same architecture but other weights?
Setup: C API (rknn_perf_bench_in, a build of ai/board/bench/rknn_perf_bench.c with the optional input argument, md5 logged), cell a4i4 (app and NPU interrupts on CPU4, the most stable cell, std about 0.01 to 0.05 ms), irqbalance stopped, frequencies locked, CORE_0. Inputs (UINT8 NHWC 640x640x3): zeros, random (fixed seed 12345), img1 and img2 (two ppe5 test images, letterbox 640 with gray 114, RGB, listed in inputs/inputs.txt). Models: s0 (best-rk3588.rknn of ppe5_yolov8n_baseline_100ep_s0, as everywhere) and s1 (INT8 export of ppe5_yolov8n_baseline_100ep_s1, same architecture, other weights, exported 2026-10-31 with the same make export-npu).
Conditions: s0-zeros (reference), s0-random, s0-img1, s0-img2, s1-zeros, s1-img1, s0-zerosb (a second reference block at the end of the half, same as s0-zeros). Order: list then reversed (14 blocks), 50 warm-up and 300 timed runs, 20 s rest.
Drift check (before any statement): in each half, |median(s0-zeros) - median(s0-zerosb)| must be at most 0.05 ms. If not, both statements are 'không áp dụng (trôi giữa các khối vượt 0.05 ms)'. The reference of a half is the mean of its two s0-zeros blocks.
Realized block: app on CPU4 in at least 99 percent of runs and at least 99 percent of irq 36 interrupts on CPU4.
Statements (difference = median of the condition minus the reference of the same half):
  Inputs (s0-random, s0-img1, s0-img2): if every |difference| <= 0.05 ms in both halves: 'thời gian không phụ thuộc giá trị đầu vào trong các đầu vào đã thử'. If any |difference| > 0.25 ms in both halves: 'thời gian phụ thuộc giá trị đầu vào'. Otherwise 'chưa kết luận'.
  Weights (s1-zeros against s0-zeros, s1-img1 against s0-img1): same thresholds, 'thời gian không phụ thuộc giá trị trọng số trong hai mô hình đã thử' or 'phụ thuộc' or 'chưa kết luận'.
  0.05 ms and 0.25 ms are new numbers, not user approved.
